# Arm ASTC Encoder

Vendored from Arm Software ASTC Encoder 5.7.1.

Upstream: https://github.com/ARM-software/astc-encoder
Pinned commit: 0affb51aaf0e0de3a8b038fa32487d59754a1eed
License: Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE.txt.

The Source directory contains the core codec implementation and public C API. The command-line frontend and image I/O dependencies are not included. NXNative will call the public API from astcenc.h.
